Most standard hangovers ease within 24 hours, though some symptoms can stretch to 48 to 72 hours.⁠National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA) (.gov) +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-h0i5HaCK8OhhvzvDW3Eagj5d1-liLIGxDbWestVeF8ciVvIYqdFdIYfB0aB9ggsP6ugQoqxyWAB8LmpcTiug10wMN4lN-LSndEwMeAIivjEpxrE8hPEkaMQ0sUllmnnDDJM9U53QNBIFA3HmykGd5lc4P-ERZgz_yvODovrF4q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOUztgj-0oCqehj9BePlhHYJc7oAhIiVBuIQ6nPckcpRCSvnlBZXRDQt74AucYKNgKUMZebYpXydbjieEUNEyC4fB5TSfXNxiqIHau6IZhqNCXXlZaon2Km3uye2qwjNH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF16hDAexIDd8qg4jlsqCf9RGbew9SWCuimzldiRvu6xqEKU5lYebU-K5S8OJX5PWXf2qjfxkEV4Y1jCqrpzwYyV1x83EZVcwXKuxkXWZ07BxAh1_w_gRwjvGZCKygMSivsXjVBvoajk24OXITBbPP6DLv15x3603bRW9MYJxRAxE2_l3EtbJpJlyuoGhBzj9zKTthnuxT5993vuBPcq0dcprgFcc)

### Why Day 2 Can Hit Harder

- **Lingering inflammation and fatigue:** Alcohol triggers an immune and inflammatory response, and fatigue in particular can persist well past a day.⁠Pure IV  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOUztgj-0oCqehj9BePlhHYJc7oAhIiVBuIQ6nPckcpRCSvnlBZXRDQt74AucYKNgKUMZebYpXydbjieEUNEyC4fB5TSfXNxiqIHau6IZhqNCXXlZaon2Km3uye2qwjNH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF13CcszDG1IrOldY5re_Q7QhNe4JI0AqgefZj6DLsMjBt11N9Y17AfmkPW5SiWbP49y9haUBi_uItjsHyFP0DMMlWVgw4IHE6Bqq8i9hKJOMLzMuo-PefXwzxnBrTVXu9CCuF-9Mly-usK7UKAoBib7dmEvPjQmLhCzU2w_9d6FDepwOVkfOYN5_b2_U)
- **Cumulative sleep debt:** Alcohol disrupts restorative REM sleep and causes restless nights, leaving you exhausted even after the alcohol leaves your system.⁠Nutritionist Resource  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF197mVviS0UGLQPhoYJ4deK05e1aSWJZ0XkOM0v4bekb1qZw4nlJE2BQeiAbZKGqJ9tiHOfxsnQ46lEv4Ja0Hn1JhWmxOC5GZOngZOtJHN18WMQsb8z1bva4qSRZWnl5I6r0DbA8zJt9wofk3amP8m3gkNP5-5IT9fPxBYdefRRHVuoWGio_691s)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOUztgj-0oCqehj9BePlhHYJc7oAhIiVBuIQ6nPckcpRCSvnlBZXRDQt74AucYKNgKUMZebYpXydbjieEUNEyC4fB5TSfXNxiqIHau6IZhqNCXXlZaon2Km3uye2qwjNH)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXIy3XAWnkG9hMkjV3vu8uYAMoZadkviGpHxTS1cSHDjtZLjQXtaG86cyCBMXChHjFF2AeyR__W7UOsJDJW7WOv2tK_CRtYyIaSl9iIufc3v7rNjcF8F9n1PyoBuqW3O-DrQ)
- **Ongoing dehydration and stomach irritation:** Fluid loss and stomach lining irritation take time to resolve, especially if you ate little or drank on multiple consecutive days.⁠Pure IV  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOUztgj-0oCqehj9BePlhHYJc7oAhIiVBuIQ6nPckcpRCSvnlBZXRDQt74AucYKNgKUMZebYpXydbjieEUNEyC4fB5TSfXNxiqIHau6IZhqNCXXlZaon2Km3uye2qwjNH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESvQEBxCJF11h6hMJ6QgJ4Czq9J2_pwWEdhksyjvOgM2LJ_Q0TYOTB5nLPJF149HND0v04w-whYpx8DBkhv_edsKqOz7LZiIL915kc_wQY523rO8k7qPk2RRLGE2ZqjsN45blTJx5xCH-XhAb-MuZIQ1l2JnMYG8v1Df1bJXV6afJHttg4tqpkF3dPaGYPLzypwD9Dc2cK5Y60OgURurEjbvrUK0jL6amV_KYa9bP8Qmp3hWU3Bmvf5bmqhFdDm3s)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF197mVviS0UGLQPhoYJ4deK05e1aSWJZ0XkOM0v4bekb1qZw4nlJE2BQeiAbZKGqJ9tiHOfxsnQ46lEv4Ja0Hn1JhWmxOC5GZOngZOtJHN18WMQsb8z1bva4qSRZWnl5I6r0DbA8zJt9wofk3amP8m3gkNP5-5IT9fPxBYdefRRHVuoWGio_691s)
- **Slower recovery with age:** Shifts in metabolism, sleep architecture, and immune sensitivity can make multi-day recovery more common as you get older.⁠Yahoo Health[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF16hDAexIDd8qg4jlsqCf9RGbew9SWCuimzldiRvu6xqEKU5lYebU-K5S8OJX5PWXf2qjfxkEV4Y1jCqrpzwYyV1x83EZVcwXKuxkXWZ07BxAh1_w_gRwjvGZCKygMSivsXjVBvoajk24OXITBbPP6DLv15x3603bRW9MYJxRAxE2_l3EtbJpJlyuoGhBzj9zKTthnuxT5993vuBPcq0dcprgFcc)
- **Possible alcohol withdrawal:** If you drink heavily on a regular basis and experience worsening shaking, heavy sweating, a racing heart, or severe anxiety, seek medical care promptly, as withdrawal can be dangerous.⁠Pure IV[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOUztgj-0oCqehj9BePlhHYJc7oAhIiVBuIQ6nPckcpRCSvnlBZXRDQt74AucYKNgKUMZebYpXydbjieEUNEyC4fB5TSfXNxiqIHau6IZhqNCXXlZaon2Km3uye2qwjNH)

### What Helps You Recover
According to the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-h0i5HaCK8OhhvzvDW3Eagj5d1-liLIGxDbWestVeF8ciVvIYqdFdIYfB0aB9ggsP6ugQoqxyWAB8LmpcTiug10wMN4lN-LSndEwMeAIivjEpxrE8hPEkaMQ0sUllmnnDDJM9U53QNBIFA3HmykGd5lc4P-ERZgz_yvODovrF4q) , only time truly cures a hangover, while caffeine or "hair of the dog" does not fix it. To stay comfortable while your body recovers:⁠National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA) (.gov)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-h0i5HaCK8OhhvzvDW3Eagj5d1-liLIGxDbWestVeF8ciVvIYqdFdIYfB0aB9ggsP6ugQoqxyWAB8LmpcTiug10wMN4lN-LSndEwMeAIivjEpxrE8hPEkaMQ0sUllmnnDDJM9U53QNBIFA3HmykGd5lc4P-ERZgz_yvODovrF4q)

- Sip water or electrolyte drinks steadily.
- Eat bland, easy-to-digest foods when your stomach settles.
- Prioritize rest and sleep.
- Use caution with pain relievers—avoid acetaminophen if your liver is stressed from alcohol, and check with a pharmacist or doctor if you have stomach irritation.⁠Cleveland Clinic  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXyJD9H97-aPNudbddkStUmfLY4La9qi_kjVV5h57HV2f0MxKv6zs3weNB7qhoMtW8Q07iaZ2hnyMJeHxqr8-lFi_HiAkpykkK_YSz9DJ3m3pz4isaTmnmz3vc8HOX6OPkEUcnMJ4tHDYLqT7kbeFfJyTfeA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXWtmu6Op8aoS9ekr5ToYrntMTXa0ZyxXUSyCg3JqVgzZSlAUmt9-OYDXBtjoYBh-Bn0te6KaDBMGBnAPBIAMS34UM9giptNwGx74RckTvZVCKJEqkSRs5XRel9uy8eqK7W0gYSJ8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqAEBxCJF16hDAexIDd8qg4jlsqCf9RGbew9SWCuimzldiRvu6xqEKU5lYebU-K5S8OJX5PWXf2qjfxkEV4Y1jCqrpzwYyV1x83EZVcwXKuxkXWZ07BxAh1_w_gRwjvGZCKygMSivsXjVBvoajk24OXITBbPP6DLv15x3603bRW9MYJxRAxE2_l3EtbJpJlyuoGhBzj9zKTthnuxT5993vuBPcq0dcprgFcc)

Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1xz1VmlS83OsP9C_6FLSQqpCH0YbbE3hgOVTovqDdOuuU3V77ZnQj1tNkpNG2i-EBT2QjFYnmacaLSrCEuuQH1iEYHSvMPFh6pf9qI29CGxwp-MOqVdQdpO-YB34GTiUgbQu-yuZSXdT-r92lKHUhdzcUzu37LzgxjTu9RaRz5R0RVKVgV3ZgLMmYuFiVDz0A6WYJso) agree that feeling noticeably worse or more irritable and drained on the second day after drinking is a common experience rather than just an isolated fluke.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1xz1VmlS83OsP9C_6FLSQqpCH0YbbE3hgOVTovqDdOuuU3V77ZnQj1tNkpNG2i-EBT2QjFYnmacaLSrCEuuQH1iEYHSvMPFh6pf9qI29CGxwp-MOqVdQdpO-YB34GTiUgbQu-yuZSXdT-r92lKHUhdzcUzu37LzgxjTu9RaRz5R0RVKVgV3ZgLMmYuFiVDz0A6WYJso)
